summary.zh: local 只存浏览器；rest 按 backend-handoff 契约同步到服务端
summary.en: local keeps it in the browser; rest syncs with the server per the backend-handoff contract

summary.zh: off 关闭；openai-compatible 读者自带密钥，浏览器直连；proxy 经服务端代理
summary.en: off; openai-compatible with the reader's own key from the browser; proxy through the server

summary.zh: 来源：讲义 frontmatter、graph.json，或两者合并
summary.en: Source: lecture frontmatter, graph.json, or both merged

summary.zh: none 不同步；notion 由服务端或本机脚本只读拉取
summary.en: none; notion pulled read-only by the server or local scripts

summary.zh: none；trusted-header 信任网关注入的身份头；oidc 仅预留
summary.en: none; trusted-header trusts the identity header set by the gateway; oidc reserved

summary.zh: 本仓库对 Notion 全程只读
summary.en: This repository only ever reads from Notion

summary.zh: 远程前端机的 SSH 与站点目录
summary.en: SSH access and site directories of the web host

summary.zh: 讲义检索与 Notion 进度同步 API
summary.en: Lecture search and Notion progress sync API

summary.zh: 仓库根 sync.py 使用的工作副本位置
summary.en: Working copies used by sync.py at the repository root

summary.zh: 端到端测试的目标地址与数据
summary.en: Targets and data for end-to-end tests

summary.zh: 原先硬编码绝对路径的替代
summary.en: Replacements for formerly hard-coded absolute paths

summary.zh: 本机启用了哪些工具模块
summary.en: Which tool modules this checkout uses

description.zh: 进度存在哪里：local 只在本机浏览器，rest 按 docs/backend-handoff 契约同步到服务端
description.en: Where progress lives: local in the browser only, rest synced per the docs/backend-handoff contract

description.zh: rest 适配器的基础路径（同源，不带结尾斜杠），其下是 /progress 与 /progress/batch
description.en: Base path of the rest adapter (same origin, no trailing slash); /progress and /progress/batch live below it

description.zh: 进度写入后经现有 Notion 同步代理回写 Notion（令牌只在服务端）
description.en: After a progress write, also update Notion through the existing sync proxy (the token stays server-side)

description.zh: 伴读后端：off 关闭；openai-compatible 读者自带密钥、浏览器直连；proxy 走服务端代理（本站 Dify）
description.en: Companion backend: off; openai-compatible with the reader's own key; proxy through the server

description.zh: 先修关系来源：讲义 frontmatter 的 requires、site/data/graph.json，或两者合并
description.en: Prerequisites from lecture frontmatter `requires`, site/data/graph.json, or both merged

description.zh: 内容同步：none 不同步；notion 只读拉取（需要 notion 模块的令牌与数据库 ID）
description.en: Content sync: none, or notion pulled read-only (needs the notion module token and database id)

description.zh: 认证：none；trusted-header 信任网关注入的身份头；oidc 仅预留
description.en: Authentication: none; trusted-header from the gateway; oidc reserved

description.zh: 身份接口路径：返回当前请求者是谁（adapter 为 none 时前端不请求）
description.en: Path of the identity endpoint that says who the requester is (not requested when adapter is none)

description.zh: Notion 内部集成令牌（ntn_ 开头）。在 notion.so/my-integrations 创建，并在目标数据库「连接」里添加该集成，否则接口返回 404。本仓库对 Notion 只读；令牌泄露过就立刻吊销重建
description.en: Notion internal integration token (starts with ntn_). Add the integration to the database's connections or the API returns 404. Read-only use; revoke it if it ever leaks

description.zh: Notion REST API 版本号，协议约定值，一般不用改
description.en: Notion REST API version; a protocol constant, rarely changed

settings.example: <32 位十六进制数据库 ID>

description.zh: 知识节点数据库 ID（32 位十六进制，带不带连字符均可），私有工作区标识
description.en: Knowledge-node database id (32 hex digits, dashes optional); a private workspace identifier

description.zh: 教学法归档目标页面 ID，只有归档脚本使用
description.en: Archive target page id, used only by the archiving script

description.zh: 目标主机地址。真实地址只写在 .env 或环境变量里，不要写回代码
description.en: Target host. Keep the real address in .env or the environment, never in code

description.zh: SSH 端口
description.en: SSH port

description.zh: SSH 登录用户
description.en: SSH user

description.zh: SSH 私钥路径。留空用跨平台默认 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519；不要写死某个用户名
description.en: SSH private key path; defaults to ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 on every platform

description.zh: SSH 私钥内容（PEM 全文）。CI 或沙箱挂不了文件时整段注入，与 DEPLOY_SSH_KEY 同时存在时优先；多行值用双引号包裹
description.en: SSH private key content (full PEM) for CI; wins over DEPLOY_SSH_KEY; wrap multi-line values in double quotes

description.zh: 远端站点根目录（部署产物落地处，通常是 nginx 的 root）
description.en: Remote site root (where the build lands; usually the nginx root)

description.zh: 本地待部署的 dist 目录（相对仓库根或绝对路径）
description.en: Local dist directory to deploy (relative to the repo root, or absolute)

description.zh: 本地↔线上逐文件比对用的基线 dist 目录；留空回退到 DEPLOY_LOCAL_DIST
description.en: Baseline dist for local-vs-remote comparison; falls back to DEPLOY_LOCAL_DIST

description.zh: 生产站点域名（只写主机名，不带 https:// 与结尾斜杠）。留空时跳过服务端可达性自测
description.en: Production site host name (no scheme, no trailing slash); empty skips the reachability check

description.zh: 认证网关域名（Authelia 等登录页），用于可达性自测；不用可留空
description.en: Auth gateway host name (e.g. Authelia), for the reachability check; optional

description.zh: 公开站点的完整地址，如 https://lectures.example.org；设置后生成 sitemap.xml 与 hreflang 互指。私有站留空
description.en: Full public address of the site, e.g. https://lectures.example.org; when set, sitemap.xml and hreflang cross-links are generated. Leave empty for a private site

description.zh: 部署目标的显示名，只用于日志，不参与连接
description.en: Display name of the target, for logs only

description.zh: 旧版部署配置文件位置（默认 scripts/deploy.local.env，仍兼容读取）；新配置请写 .env
description.en: Legacy deploy config file (default scripts/deploy.local.env, still read); put new settings in .env

description.zh: 微服务监听地址
description.en: Tools service listen address

description.zh: 微服务监听端口
description.en: Tools service listen port

description.zh: 远端 nginx 站点配置目录（部署微服务时注入 location 用）
description.en: Remote nginx sites directory (for injecting the service location)

description.zh: 远端微服务源码落地路径
description.en: Remote path of the tools service source

description.zh: 真实工作副本目录（VitePress 站点源码）。留空则 sync.py 以本仓库 site/ 为工作副本
description.en: Working copy of the VitePress site; empty makes sync.py use this repo's site/

description.zh: 上游知识库工作副本根目录，没有默认值
description.en: Root of the upstream knowledge-base working copy; no default

description.zh: 端到端测试打的站点根 URL（含 https://，不带结尾斜杠）；留空时测试明确报缺配置
description.en: Site root URL for end-to-end tests (with https://, no trailing slash)

description.zh: 端到端测试用的 Notion 页面 ID，属个人数据，没有默认值
description.en: Notion page id used by end-to-end tests; personal data, no default

description.zh: 进度同步 API 完整端点（本地直连测试用）；留空则脚本明确报错
description.en: Full progress-sync endpoint for the direct test; empty makes the script fail clearly

description.zh: 本地知识图谱 JSON 路径；留空回退到 site/docs/public/notion_knowledge_graph.json
description.en: Local knowledge-graph JSON; defaults to site/docs/public/notion_knowledge_graph.json

description.zh: AI 伴读提示词与快捷动作 JSON 路径；留空回退到 site/prompts/companion.json
description.en: Path to the AI companion prompts JSON file; defaults to site/prompts/companion.json

description.zh: 本机使用的工具模块（逗号分隔，由 npm run setup 写入）；留空时 doctor 按已设置的键推断
description.en: Tool modules this checkout uses (comma-separated, written by setup); empty lets doctor infer them

description.zh: 访问分档：声明谁能读哪个课程组。构建产物保证受限组的讲名、正文、图表数据、知识图谱节点与搜索内容只出现在该档受保护的路径下（网关按路径前缀拦截）
description.en: Access tiers: declares who may read which course group. The build guarantees that titles, text, chart data, graph nodes and search content of a restricted group appear only under the protected paths of its tier (a gateway blocks by path prefix)

description.zh: 未单独声明的课程组所属的档，也是首页与非组页面的档
description.en: Tier of every course group that is not listed under `groups`, and of the home page and other non-group pages

description.zh: gateway：部署在认证网关之后，允许存在受限内容；none：没有网关，构建遇到受限内容就失败
description.en: gateway: deployed behind an authenticating gateway, restricted content is allowed; none: no gateway, the build fails on restricted content

description.zh: 课程组 id -> { read }，read 为 public、authenticated 或网关用户组名数组（不能为空）
description.en: Course group id -> { read }; read is public, authenticated, or a non-empty array of gateway user-group names

description.zh: 首页：地图默认显示模式（速览 / 依赖画布）以及速览地图默认展开到哪一档。读者自己的选择优先于这里的默认值
description.en: Home page: default home map mode (atlas / graph) and how far the overview map is expanded by default. A reader's own choice wins over this default

description.zh: atlas：课程速览横向思维导图；graph：课程依赖画布（显示先修连线与追踪）
description.en: atlas: horizontal overview mind map; graph: prerequisite dependency canvas

description.zh: reading：在读的组展开到读到的阶段；progress：有已读或在读讲次的组和阶段都展开；all：全部展开；none：全部收起
description.en: reading: groups being read open down to the phase being read; progress: every group and phase with a read or reading lecture; all: everything; none: everything collapsed
